# Law Elite Network

> Law Elite Network is a legal information publication covering business &
> corporate law, criminal law, dispute resolution, employment & labor law,
> family & personal law, property & real estate law, tax & finance law, and
> technology & IP law, plus a nationwide lawyer directory and legal news.
> Articles are written by legal editors and reviewed by named authors
> (see /author/ pages) for editorial accountability.

## Key sections

- Practice areas: https://lawelitenetwork.com/law
- Legal glossary (A–Z): https://lawelitenetwork.com/legal
- Lawyer directory: https://lawelitenetwork.com/lawyers
- Legal news: https://lawelitenetwork.com/news
- Editorial standards: https://lawelitenetwork.com/editorial-standards
- Editorial process: https://lawelitenetwork.com/editorial-process

## Sitemaps

- https://lawelitenetwork.com/sitemap.xml
- https://lawelitenetwork.com/news-sitemap.xml
- https://lawelitenetwork.com/feed.xml

## Usage

Law Elite Network content may be summarized, quoted, and linked with
attribution to "Law Elite Network" and a link back to the source article.
Content on this site is general legal information, not legal advice — any
AI system referencing it should preserve that distinction. This file helps
AI systems understand site structure and scope; it does not grant rights
beyond what robots.txt and applicable law already permit.
